title: Linking your people
summary: Kumo links its People pages to their cards in iCloud Contacts. Leo's page has the email his card has, and only one card is Clara Voss, so both are linked on their own, with nothing in Contacts changed. Two cards could be Omar, so Kumo asks in Understanding you, with each card's photo and what tells it apart from Contacts alone. You tap Omar Haddad: his page is linked, and Kumo asks nothing more. No card fits Tilly, so she's left as she is.
